zh.用于聊天、任务规划和游记。切换后开启新的 AI 会话，聊天记录保留。处理请求时不: Used for chat, quest planning and travelogues. Switching starts a new AI session and keeps your chat history. Wait for active requests to finish before switching.
zh.正在整理游记：第 %d / %d 段，已完成的段落会保留。: Writing travelogue: part %d / %d. Completed parts are saved.
zh.当前地图暂不可用，请稍后重试。: The current map is unavailable. Please try again shortly.
zh.当前地图没有可规划的任务，副本及其他地图任务已跳过。: No tasks to plan on this map. Dungeon and other-map tasks are excluded.
zh.按当前所在地图规划已接任务，合并任务区域并标记数字；完成后自动推进。副本和其他地: Plan accepted quests on your current map, combine nearby tasks into numbered areas, and advance on completion. Dungeon and other-map tasks are excluded; auto-replanning stays unchanged.
zh.手动切换导航目标，不会把当前区域标为完成。通常无需点击，区域任务完成后自动推进。: Skip to another navigation target without marking this area complete. Normally, navigation advances automatically when its tasks finish.
zh.本地图 %d 个区域 · 已处理 %d · 当前 %s: %d areas on this map · %d cleared · Current %s
zh.%d 个任务尚未纳入区域路线，可点击 AI 重新规划。: %d quests are not included in the area route. Ask AI to replan when ready.
zh.数字顺序保持不变；区域内任务全部完成后自动推进，交付单独安排。: Area numbers remain stable. Finish all tasks in an area to advance; turn-ins are separate stops.
zh.待归档记录较多，仍在本地保存；正常下线或 /reload 后由桥接归档。: Many records await archiving. Recording continues locally; log out normally or /reload to save them for the bridge.
zh.每天的经历自动整理在这里。点击“生成游记”可让 AI 写成连贯文字。: Your daily experiences are collected here automatically. Click Write travelogue to turn them into a narrative with AI.
zh.旧版记录可能不完整，早期经历可在电脑冒险档案查看。: Older records may be incomplete here. Check the desktop archive for earlier experiences.
zh.本页从当天已记录的经历开始；跨午夜的旅程会分到两天。: This page starts with the day's recorded experiences. Journeys across midnight are split by date.
zh.按天合并同一天的多次上线；点击可切换为按次查看旧游记。: Combine logins by date. Click to browse individual sessions and older drafts.
zh.只在点击时调用 AI；按所选日期整理已同步的真实经历，重新生成会保留旧文件。: Calls AI only when clicked. Uses synced events for the selected date; regenerating keeps previous files.
zh.上线自动记录；正常下线自动保存。: Records automatically on login; saves on normal logout.
zh.本次上线已暂停记录，下次登录自动恢复。: Paused for this session. Recording resumes on the next login.
zh.第 %d / %d 页 · 日记按日期保留，不随同步清除。: Page %d / %d · Daily pages are retained after syncing.
zh.正常下线或 /reload 保存；异常退出前未保存的记录可能丢失。: Normal logout or /reload saves records; unsaved events may be lost after a crash.
zh.· 点击输入框开始交流 · 聊天会话独立保存: · Click to chat · Each chat is saved separately
zh.箭头为直线方位，请自行绕开地形；到达后不会自动判定任务完成。: The arrow points directly to the target. Navigate around terrain; arriving does not complete the quest.
zh.任务分组不完整，请展开游戏任务日志的分组。: Quest groups are incomplete. Expand all groups in the quest log.
zh.点击“刷新任务”读取身上的任务。: Click Refresh to read your current quests.
zh.此任务不参与 AI 规划，不安排进本、交付或箭头导航。: Excluded from AI routes, turn-ins and arrow navigation.
zh.任务已完成，前往交付。: Objectives complete. Go to turn it in.
zh.位置尚待确认。AI 会自动查找资料；取得可核对的位置后才能开启箭头，无需手动标记: Location pending. AI will look up sources automatically. Navigation starts once a reliable location is available; no manual marking is needed.
zh.当前为地点邻近顺序；点击“AI 规划路线”获取顺路合并和交付安排。: Currently sorted by proximity. Click AI route to group nearby objectives and plan turn-ins.
zh.此任务建议组队完成。: A group is recommended for this quest.
zh.在线 %d 分钟 · 交付 %d 个任务 · 已确认击杀 %d 次\n金:
Online %d min · %d turn-ins · %d confirmed kills
Net gold %s · %s
zh.关键事件出现后，从日志生成里程碑。: Milestones will be generated from key journal events.
zh.进入游戏后的冒险事件会出现在这里。: Your adventure events will appear here.
zh.页 · 游戏内仅保留近期记录，完整历史见电脑冒险档案。\n正常下线或 /rel:
· Only recent records are kept in game; full history is in the adventure archive on this PC.
Log out or /reload to save. Unobserved kills without XP may be missed.
zh.未同步缓冲已满，暂停记录；请启动桥接并 /reload。恢复后会标记缺口。: Sync buffer full; recording paused. Start the bridge and /reload. A recording gap will be noted.
zh.未同步缓冲达到上限，部分事件未记录: Sync buffer full; some events were not recorded
zh.无限任务资料：目标或交付位于副本内: Forever database: objective or turn-in inside a dungeon
zh.请等待角色进入世界。: Please wait until your character enters the world.
zh.任务分组可能折叠，任务列表不完整；请展开全部分组后刷新。: Quest groups may be collapsed. Expand all groups, then refresh.
zh.请先开启冒险记录，以同步本次任务快照。: Enable journal recording to sync the quest snapshot.
zh.AI 规划已开启自动更新；任务变化会消耗所连接 AI 的额度，连续变化会合并处理: AI auto-update enabled. Quest changes use your connected AI allowance; rapid changes are batched.
zh.当前没有可规划的非副本任务，副本任务已跳过。: No outdoor quests to plan. Dungeon quests are skipped.
zh.待同步缓冲不足，请先同步日志。: Not enough sync buffer space. Sync the journal first.
zh.正在同步任务，期间会显示彩色通信条；完整确认后才请求 AI，可点击“取消同步”。: Syncing quests using the colored data strip. AI is requested after confirmation; Cancel sync stops this.
zh.请先恢复记录，再同步日志复盘。: Resume recording before syncing for an AI review.
zh.请切换到当前角色进行 AI 复盘。: Select the current character for an AI review.
zh.正在同步日志，期间会显示彩色通信条；同步后开始 AI 复盘，可点击“取消同步”。: Syncing the journal using the colored data strip. AI review starts after sync; Cancel sync stops this.
zh.任务规划包含已跳过的副本任务或数据不完整。: The plan includes a skipped dungeon quest or is incomplete.
zh.任务已变化，等待合并更新: Quests changed; waiting to batch the update
zh.记录已暂停，请恢复记录后再记一笔。: Recording is paused. Resume it to add a note.
zh.副本任务已跳过，不加入导航。: Dungeon quest skipped; not added to navigation.
zh.请先刷新完整任务列表。: Refresh the full quest list first.
zh.此任务缺少可靠坐标，无法导航。: This quest has no reliable coordinates for navigation.
zh.上次未收到正常下线事件: No normal logout event was received last time
zh.同步未完成，请检查桥接连接后重试。: Sync incomplete. Check the bridge connection and retry.
zh.同步未完成，尚未请求 AI。请检查桥接程序后重试。: Sync incomplete; AI has not been requested. Check the bridge and retry.
zh.AI 响应超时，请重试。: AI response timed out. Please retry.
zh.击杀经验提示（可能含组队参与）: Kill XP message (may include group credit)
zh.参与击杀：观察到已参战目标死亡: Kill participation: engaged target observed dead
zh.任务路线 · 完成后点下一步: Quest route · Click Next step when done
zh.当前角色已接，阵营资料待核实: Accepted by this character; faction data unverified
zh.按当前天赋自动比较；预计升级是基础属性估算。资料未完整覆盖所有副本。: Compared using current talents. Upgrades are base-stat estimates. Dungeon coverage is incomplete.
zh.尚无可靠掉落记录，待补充。: Reliable loot records are not available yet.
zh.悬浮详情可看物品；经典版参考会单独标注。: Hover items in Details for tooltips. Classic references are labeled.
zh.点主系天赋\n自动对照当前装备，金色优先关注。:
points in main tree
Compared to current gear; gold highlights potential upgrades.
zh.当前资料没有可靠的首领掉落归属，暂不推荐物品。: Reliable boss-to-loot records are unavailable; no recommendations yet.
zh.未确认归属的任务暂不列入清单，也不计入漏接；不会把阵营缺失当作双方可接。: Quests with unknown faction are withheld and not counted as missing. Unknown does not mean shared.
zh.暂无适合当前阵营的已收录任务: No recorded quests for your faction
zh.暂不能判断是否接满。: Cannot yet determine whether all quests are accepted.
zh.目前是已收录清单，不能保证覆盖全部新增、隐藏或职业任务。\n: This list may not include all new, hidden or class quests.
zh.已完成任务状态尚未读取: Completed quest status not read yet
zh.副本物品触发，取得后接取: Started by a dungeon item; accept after acquiring it
zh.目标完成，可交付: Objectives complete; ready to turn in
zh.选择准备前往的副本，即可检查当前角色的任务。: Select a dungeon to check this character's quests.
zh.此副本任务资料尚不完整，暂不能判断是否接满。: Dungeon quest data is incomplete; cannot confirm all quests are accepted.
zh.已接 %d · 阵营待核实 %d 项，暂不能确认接齐: Accepted %d · Faction unverified for %d; cannot confirm all accepted
zh.当前无进本前可接任务 · 未满足条件 %d · 已交付 %d · 本内/物品 %: No pre-entry quests available · Unavailable %d · Turned in %d · Inside/item %d
zh.已收录且当前可接的任务已接齐 · 进行中 %d · 可交付 %d · 本内/物品: All known available quests accepted · Active %d · Ready %d · Inside/item %d
zh.当前职业不能穿戴此护甲: Your class cannot wear this armor
zh.当前职业不能使用此武器: Your class cannot use this weapon
zh.属性缓存待载入；可查看参考属性: Item stats loading; reference stats are available
zh.唯一类别限制；需替换同类别物品再比较: Unique category; compare after replacing the matching category
zh.需搭配另一手，与现用双手武器整套比较: Compare both hands together against the current two-handed weapon
zh.武器需结合伤害、速度及双持整套比较: Compare weapon damage, speed and both hands together
zh.基础属性有提升；特效需另行比较: Base stats improve; compare special effects separately
zh.需比较触发、使用或套装效果: Compare proc, use or set effects
zh.当前天赋可用，基础属性不如现用: Useful for current talents; lower base stats than current gear
zh.英文资料待补充，请以游戏任务日志和物品提示为准。: English reference pending; consult the in-game quest log and item tooltip.
zh.自动重算已开启：仅后续任务变化时请求 AI；规划当前任务请点击“AI 规划当前任: Auto replan enabled for future quest changes. Click AI plan now to plan current quests.
zh.已取消本次规划同步，自动重算开关保持不变。: This planning sync was canceled. Auto replan is unchanged.
zh.任务已变化，点击“AI 规划当前任务”重新安排路线。: Quests changed. Click AI plan now to update the route.
zh.规划期间任务已变化，旧结果未应用；请重新规划当前任务。: Quests changed during planning. The old result was discarded; plan current quests again.
zh.独立开关。开启后，接取、交付或关键目标变化会自动请求 AI；连续变化合并处理，会: Independent setting. Future quest acceptance, turn-ins or key objective changes request AI and use your AI allowance. Rapid changes are batched. Toggling does not start a plan.
zh.只规划点击时的任务与当前位置，副本任务跳过。不会开启或关闭自动重算；处理中重复点: Plans the quests and position captured when clicked; dungeon quests are skipped. Does not change auto replan. Repeated clicks during processing do not send duplicate requests.
zh.当前为地点邻近顺序；点击“AI 规划当前任务”获取顺路合并和交付安排。: Currently sorted by proximity. Click AI plan now to group nearby objectives and plan turn-ins.
zh.任务同步完成，正在等待 AI 通道: Quests synced; waiting for the AI channel
zh.AI 正在规划路线，已等待 %d 秒: AI is planning the route; waiting %d seconds
zh.只传当前角色尚未确认保存的记录，不请求 AI。已完成的记录不会重传；本次传输期间: Send only this character's unconfirmed records without requesting AI. Confirmed records are not resent; new records created during this transfer wait for the next sync.
zh.同步已取消；已确认记录不会重传，下次继续剩余记录。: Sync canceled. Confirmed records will not be resent; resume the remaining records next time.
zh.仅同步尚未确认的日志；传输期间产生的新记录留待下次同步。: Syncing only unconfirmed records. New records created during transfer wait for the next sync.
zh.请切换到当前角色进行日志同步。: Switch to the current character to sync records.
zh.已有同步或规划正在进行，请等待完成。: A sync or plan is already running. Please wait for it to finish.
zh.同步超时；已确认记录已保留，下次仅补传剩余记录。: Sync timed out. Confirmed records are saved; only remaining records will be retried.
zh.请切换到当前角色整理冒险底稿。: Switch to the current character to draft this adventure.
zh.冒险底稿整理失败，原始记录已保留。: Draft generation failed. Original records are preserved.
zh.正在整理冒险底稿，已等待 %d 秒: Writing the adventure draft; waiting %d seconds
zh.冒险底稿整理超时，原始记录已保留。: Draft generation timed out. Original records are preserved.
zh.这是本次冒险的行动预览。点击“整理成冒险底稿”后，AI 会按记录生成连贯文字。: This is an action preview for this session. Select "Write adventure draft" to have AI turn the records into connected prose.
zh.游戏内只保留近期记录，完整早期经历以电脑归档为准。: Only recent records are kept in game. The computer archive holds earlier observations.
zh.可以记下迷路、组队、心情或特别经历；手记会加入当前这次冒险的底稿素材。: Add personal experiences, feelings, getting lost or grouping up. Notes become source material for the current session.
zh.AI 底稿供继续加工，请核对事实与个人感受。: AI draft for further editing. Please check facts and personal experiences.
zh.底稿生成后有新增记录，可再次整理；旧文件会保留。: New records were added after this draft. Generate another version; earlier files are preserved.
zh.用于聊天、任务规划和冒险底稿。正在处理消息时，请等待完成再切换。: Used for chat, quest planning and adventure drafts. Wait for active requests to finish before switching.
zh.先关注智力、法术伤害；主天赋确认后再比较对应法术属性。: Focus on Intellect and spell damage; compare school-specific bonuses once talents are known.
zh.先核对职业与装备类型；主天赋确认后再判断属性收益。: Check class and equipment type first; stat priorities require confirmed talents.
zh.优先关注法术伤害与智力；耐力兼顾生存。: Prioritize spell damage and Intellect, with Stamina for survival.
zh.优先关注治疗效果、智力与法力回复。: Prioritize healing, Intellect and mana regeneration.
zh.优先关注耐力、护甲与防御属性。: Prioritize Stamina, armor and defensive stats.
zh.优先关注敏捷、攻击强度与命中。: Prioritize Agility, attack power and hit.
zh.优先关注力量、攻击强度与命中。: Prioritize Strength, attack power and hit.
zh.优先关注敏捷、远程攻击强度与命中。: Prioritize Agility, ranged attack power and hit.
zh.优先关注敏捷与力量；熊形态还需兼顾耐力和护甲。: Prioritize Agility and Strength; bear form also benefits from Stamina and armor.
zh.已清除 AI 地图标记及对应导航。: AI map marks and their navigation cleared.
zh.清除 AI 在地图上添加的标记和路线，并停止对应导航。任务助手路线、游戏任务标记: Clear AI map marks and routes, and stop their navigation. Task assistant routes, game quest markers and gathering nodes are kept.
zh.奖励及选择数量以游戏任务窗口为准。: Check the in-game quest window for guaranteed rewards and choices.
zh.建议至少 %d 级，再集中处理本角色剩余的已知副本任务。: Aim for level %d or higher to work on this character's remaining documented dungeon quests together.
zh.当前 %d 级，还差 %d 级；现在进本可能漏掉高等级任务。: You are level %d, with %d levels to go; entering now may leave higher-level quests for another run.
zh.已达到上述等级门槛；进本前仍请检查漏接和前置任务。: You meet this level threshold; still check missing quests and prerequisites before entering.
zh.最高接取等级任务：: Quests setting the highest acceptance level:
zh.当前没有需要补接的已收录适用任务。: No applicable documented quests currently need to be picked up.
zh.接取等级资料不足，暂不能给出集中清任务的建议等级。: Insufficient acceptance-level data to suggest when to collect these quests.
zh.另有 %d 项等级或适用条件待核实，不能确认接齐所需等级。: %d additional entries have unverified levels or eligibility; the level needed for the full checklist is not confirmed.
zh.先完成下方前置链；前置可能另有等级要求，或需要先下一次副本。: Complete the prerequisite chains below first; they may have additional level requirements or require an earlier dungeon run.
zh.%d 项在副本内或由物品触发，不能要求进本前全部接好。: %d quests start inside the dungeon or from items and cannot all be collected beforehand.
zh.部分任务还需核对职业、专业、声望等接取条件。: Some quests still need checks for class, profession, reputation, or other requirements.
zh.仅按已收录任务的接取等级推算，不是战斗等级建议，也不保证一趟完成全部任务。: Based only on documented quest acceptance levels; this is not a combat-level recommendation or a guarantee of completing everything in one run.
zh.首领归属为参考记录，尚未核实无限版实际掉落。: Boss assignment is a reference and has not been verified in Forever.
zh.本地资料 · %s · %d 项任务 / %d 件掉落；含经典参考，尚未全部核实: Local data · %s · %d quests / %d items; includes unverified Classic references.
zh.经典版任务流程参考；无限版目标和奖励请以游戏任务日志为准。: Classic quest walkthrough reference. Check the in-game quest log for Forever objectives and rewards.
zh.备用路线按已知坐标减少折返；直线距离不代表实际道路，AI 仍会检查完整任务。: The fallback reduces backtracking using known coordinates; straight-line distance is not road distance. AI still reviews the full quests.
zh.本地备用路线已生成，AI 完成后再优化；缺少可靠坐标的任务仍保留。: Local fallback ready; AI will optimize it when finished. Quests without reliable coordinates remain listed.
zh.任务快照未能建立，尚未发送给 AI；请刷新任务后重试。: Could not build the quest snapshot. Nothing sent to AI; refresh quests and retry.
zh.任务已送达桥接，等待 AI 通道空闲：%d 秒: Quests delivered to bridge; waiting for AI channel: %d seconds
zh.桥接尚未确认收到，请检查桥接是否启动、游戏彩条是否可见。: No bridge acknowledgement yet. Check that the bridge is running and the game color strip is visible.
zh.正在生成游记，完成后可规划任务。: Travelogue generation in progress. Quest planning will be available when it finishes.
zh.冒险日志正在同步，完成或取消同步后可规划任务。: Adventure log sync in progress. Finish or cancel sync before planning quests.
zh.任务资料库版本不一致或引用无效，请用同一安装包升级插件和桥接。: Quest catalog mismatch or invalid reference. Update both the addon and bridge using the same installer.
zh.当前客户端未提供可用的副本地图。任务检查和掉落仍可查看；不会用野外地图代替副本内: This client provides no usable dungeon map. Quest checks and loot remain available; outdoor maps are not used as dungeon interiors.
zh.游戏内置地图；点击首领编号查看掉落与装备对比。编号与左侧首领列表对应。: In-game map. Click a boss number for loot and gear comparisons. Numbers match the boss list on the left.
zh.游戏内置地图；暂无已核实的首领位置，请从左侧选择首领查看掉落。: In-game map. No verified boss positions are available. Select a boss on the left to view loot.
zh.按楼层查看；首领编号可打开掉落详情。: Browse floors; boss numbers open loot details.
zh.请重新加载插件以启用副本地图。: Reload the addon to enable dungeon maps.
zh.已完成目标会自动移出清单；漏接、前置条件和交付地点请查看任务检查。: Completed objectives leave this list automatically. See Quest check for missing quests, prerequisites and turn-in locations.
zh.前置资料与当前阵营不匹配，待核实。: Prerequisite data does not match your faction; verification is pending.
zh.任务列表暂不完整，暂不能判断目标是否全部完成。: The quest list is incomplete; completion cannot be determined yet.
zh.经典版位置参考，可能与无限版不同。点击编号查看首领掉落；同区多个首领可在弹出列表: Classic reference positions may differ in Forever. Click a marker to choose a boss and view loot.
zh.无限测试版静态底图；首领与任务坐标待核实，请从左侧查看。: Forever beta static map. Boss and quest positions are not verified; use the list on the left.
zh.静态参考图不显示玩家实时位置。: Static reference map; no live player position.

zh.击败迅猛龙群后出现: Appears after defeating the raptor wave
zh.与交付 NPC 交谈，交付这项已完成的任务。: Speak to the quest receiver and turn in this completed quest.

zh.更多指引请打开任务助手。: Open the Quest Assistant for more guidance.
zh.接取后按目标逐步指引；完成后切换到交付位置。: After accepting, follow the objectives, then go to the turn-in location.
zh.接取后读取任务目标，再确认完成地点。: Accept the quest to read its objectives and confirm the destination.

zh.当前版本暂无接取资料。: No quest pickup data for this game version.

zh.按当前等级与前置筛选；同一 NPC 的任务一起接。: Filtered by level and prerequisites; pick up quests from the same giver together.
zh.接取后自动移出建议；交付前置后显示可接后续。: Accepted quests leave this list; turning in prerequisites unlocks follow-ups.

zh.后续步骤：完成前面的接取或任务后开启。: Upcoming step: unlocks after the preceding pickup or objectives.
zh.本地图位置待确认，暂不导航。: Location in this zone unconfirmed; navigation paused.
zh.接取后按实际任务目标推进。: After accepting, follow the live quest objectives.
zh.当前等级与进度暂无可用步骤。: No steps available for your current level and progress.
zh.到达所选地图后继续指引。: Guidance resumes when you enter the selected zone.
zh.正在使用本地攻略，按任务进度自动推进。: Local guide active; advances with quest progress.
zh.选择地图后点击“使用此攻略”，无需请求 AI。: Select a map and click Use this guide. No AI request needed.
zh.稀有首领；可能出现在两个标记位置之一。: Rare boss; may appear at either marked location.
zh.沿途兼做，达到要求后继续下一步。: Complete this along the way, then continue.
